name: app-lavender-hotel-app-with-brush-stroke-callouts
title: Hotel App with Brush-Stroke Callouts
whatItIs: Two phones (hotel search and villa detail) on a lavender panel, each accompanied by a rough blue paint-stroke banner with a feature headline and description.
whatItMeans: The rough paint strokes contrast with the polished UI, adding a human, hand-made energy to a feature explanation.
techniques: Painted blue swash as a text background
Two-tone gradient inside the brush stroke
Phones offset diagonally to create flow
Same blue as the UI buttons for cohesion
White rounded panel on a lavender field

vocabulary.definition: A rough painted stroke used behind text.
A headline and short description attached to a screen.
Placing items along a diagonal to create movement.
